race.comment: PEWTER PEARL (1) makes the strongest appeal after missing by only half a length at Gold Coast on soft ground, and the BM65 run two starts back gives her form a little more depth than most of these. The 1100m record is not flawless, but she handles rain-affected ground and looks well placed against this opposition. LADIES OCEAN RUN (3) is the main danger after running second at this track first-up as favourite, and her proven 1100m form, barrier one and reunion with Les Tilley all read well. SHAHAR (6) is better than the Toowoomba sixth suggests after being checked and tightened, and the drop from Class 2 company keeps her in the argument. Can contest for place. FINAL VOYAGE (5) is the honest one, with four straight placings and a 3kg claim helping, but her wet-track record keeps her a shade below the main pair.
